action_vocabulary.CLEAN: Small bounded correction that preserves the current component and contract where possible.
action_vocabulary.REFACTOR: Incremental consolidation around one canonical policy or transaction boundary.
action_vocabulary.REWRITE: Narrow replacement because the current adapter expresses an absent or fabricated model.
action_vocabulary.BUILD: Missing capability built only after its prerequisite domain and contract decisions are frozen.

rules: Use only an isolated checkout and a disposable or sanitized-restored PostgreSQL database.
Do not reinterpret, delete, merge, or backfill historical license, credit, progress, curriculum, or outcome rows during planning.
Keep uncertain legacy identities fail-closed until an owner-approved mapping and rehearsal evidence exist.
Every future migration needs upgrade, verification, and rollback or forward-repair evidence before approval.

technical_decisions.decision: Exactly four canonical product identifiers: LFA_FOOTBALL_PLAYER, LFA_COACH, GANCUJU_PLAYER, INTERNSHIP.
technical_decisions.basis: Audit conflict C01 and canonical four-training matrix; historical PLAYER maps to GANCUJU_PLAYER and must not be inferred from its English name.

technical_decisions.decision: Age and season variants are attributes or policy inputs, not additional product entitlements.
technical_decisions.basis: Audit F15/F16; exact age bands and cutoff remain an owner decision.

technical_decisions.decision: Credits are a global user-owned balance and immutable ledger; program, license, purchase, and operation are context only.
technical_decisions.basis: Owner-settled global-credit rule and P0 transactional baseline.

technical_decisions.decision: UserLicense is the entitlement boundary. One program progression command owns atomic level/outcome writes; SpecializationProgress holds accumulated measures, LicenseProgression holds immutable transitions, and UserLicense.current_level is the entitlement-facing projection. Web and API share the policy and native consumes the same contract.
technical_decisions.basis: Audit F15/C15 and retained P0 canonical policy pattern; sanitized data discovery must verify the projection mechanics before schema work.

technical_decisions.decision: Program education is Program -> Track/Curriculum -> Module -> Lesson/Component -> versioned assessment; lifecycle and assignment are persisted fields.
Assessment scoring accepts only a server-issued attempt and immutable content/scoring version; the same transaction stores outcome, XP/progression event, and audit evidence.
technical_decisions.basis: F12/F20/F23; no new general event platform is required.

technical_decisions.decision: Retain the modular monolith, SQLAlchemy/PostgreSQL, current workers, Jinja web, and SwiftUI native foundation.
technical_decisions.basis: Audit target architecture; only the raw-SQL curriculum adapter receives a narrow rewrite in this P1 plan.

owner_decisions.decision: Confirm exact PRE/YOUTH age boundaries, July-1 season cutoff behavior, and treatment of existing learners affected by the corrected rule.
Confirm how Internship's three levels relate to five semesters and the approved progression/completion meaning for all four programs.
Approve curriculum, assessment, localization, completion, and certificate criteria for each program and whether programs may release independently.
Decide treatment of historical entitlement/license rows and purchases whose recorded type, amount, or period cannot be mapped unambiguously.
Approve data-purpose, retention, access, and audit expectations for learner outcomes and identify any applicable qualification or regulatory standard.
Confirm whether biometrics remain disabled R&D or are intended for future production, and assign legal/DPO/accuracy approval ownership.

workstreams.title: Canonical domain contract and legacy mapping

workstreams.target_outcome: One documented and tested domain contract used by web/API and consumable by native; explicit mapping table for every observed legacy identity.
exit_criteria: Exactly four product IDs are accepted at entitlement boundaries.

Credit writes remain user-owned and P0 replay/rollback/concurrency tests remain green.
Legacy mapping report covers values and orphan/ambiguity counts without mutation.
Web and API call the same entitlement/eligibility policy.
mandatory_test_gate: migration rehearsal on disposable PostgreSQL if additive schema is proposed
workstreams.rollback: Revert the workstream code and additive schema in the disposable environment; retain mapping evidence. No historical-row rewrite is allowed in this workstream.

workstreams.title: Authentication lifecycle, invitation atomicity, and hybrid CSRF
workstreams.scope: Add single-use refresh/revocation state, atomic one-use invitation consumption, and auth-mode-aware CSRF enforcement shared by web/API dependencies.
prerequisites: documented current cookie and Bearer route inventory
workstreams.target_outcome: Replay is denied, logout/password change invalidate sessions, one-use invitations cannot be consumed twice, and cookie-authenticated writes require CSRF regardless of route prefix.
exit_criteria: Refresh rotation/reuse detection and revocation survive concurrent PostgreSQL tests.
Logout and password change revoke the intended token family/session set.
Invitation consumption is one transaction with one winner under concurrency.
Cookie-authenticated API writes enforce CSRF; valid Bearer requests remain compatible.
Sensitive logging tests from P0 remain green.
workstreams.rollback: Disable new issuance only through a reviewed compatibility switch if required, retain revocation records, and revert route wiring. Never re-enable a known replayed token.

workstreams.title: Canonical education hierarchy and content lifecycle
workstreams.scope: Map retained curriculum data to the active Track/Module/Component model, persist program/module/version ownership, and enforce one draft/published lifecycle policy.
prerequisites: DISCOVER inventory of active and legacy curriculum tables/content
workstreams.target_outcome: Mounted curriculum and adaptive selection use the active schema and explicit canonical scope; drafts cannot be selected or served.
exit_criteria: Old raw SQL endpoint behavior is replaced by a narrow active-schema adapter.
Program, hierarchy, content version, and lifecycle are durable queryable fields.
No title-prefix or description metadata is an authorization or hierarchy authority.
Draft content is unreachable from learner selection and direct fetch.
Legacy mapping completes DISCOVER/MAP/REHEARSE/VALIDATE before any later MIGRATE approval.
mandatory_test_gate: legacy mapping rehearsal on disposable PostgreSQL
workstreams.rollback: Keep source content and legacy tables untouched; roll back the adapter and additive columns in the disposable environment. Published-state rollback uses explicit status/version changes, never deletion.

workstreams.title: Assessment integrity and outcome evidence
workstreams.scope: Repair real service-handler contracts, bind answers to server-issued attempts, score the complete assessment, and atomically persist outcome/provenance/audit evidence.
workstreams.target_outcome: No omitted-answer inflation, repeated-answer XP inflation, client-authored option set, or post-commit contract failure; outcome evidence is durable and reconstructable.
exit_criteria: Real endpoint/service contract tests cover multiple-choice and fill-in paths.
Every assessment submission references one open server-issued attempt and one content/scoring version.
Denominator includes the full issued assessment and duplicate/omitted answers have defined behavior.
Outcome, XP/progression, and audit/provenance commit or roll back together.
Web/API attendance outcome history follows the same transactional rule.
workstreams.rollback: Revert new issue/submission route wiring while preserving immutable attempts and outcomes already written. Use forward status correction for durable audit rows; never delete learner outcomes.

workstreams.title: Four-program backend completion and approved content
workstreams.scope: Repair the 24 stale service call sites against canonical shared authorities, then add only owner/subject-approved curriculum and assessment mappings for the four programs.
prerequisites: OD02 and OD03 for product completion claims
workstreams.target_outcome: Mounted specialization routes have real service contracts and each released program has approved, versioned, mapped content and assessment coverage.
explicit_exclusions: copying Football content into other programs
exit_criteria: Runtime inspection reports zero missing service-method call sites in the 24-item inventory.
Credit/entitlement/progression calls delegate to canonical authorities.
Each released program has owner-approved hierarchy, content versions, assessment mapping, and completion criteria.
Incomplete programs fail closed and are not advertised as complete.
Four-program API contract and PostgreSQL journey gates pass.
workstreams.rollback: Revert adapters independently by program; retain versioned content and mark an unapproved version unavailable through lifecycle state. Never delete imported history or reassign it speculatively.

workstreams.title: Native Release stability and four-program journeys
workstreams.scope: Correct Release-only symbol guards, align native auth/API DTOs, and stage real navigation plus lesson/assessment execution for backend-ready programs.
workstreams.target_outcome: Debug and Release compile; native exposes only ready programs and executes canonical curriculum/assessment flows with typed failures.
explicit_exclusions: native availability ahead of backend truth
exit_criteria: Unsigned Debug and Release builds pass on the recorded toolchain or a documented supported toolchain.
Debug-only diagnostics are unreachable from Release compilation/runtime.
All owner-approved ready programs have non-nil native destinations.
Curriculum, assessment, refresh/revocation, and error DTO contracts match OpenAPI fixtures.
Unavailable programs show truthful availability without fake progression.
workstreams.rollback: Revert each program route behind its availability configuration while keeping the Release guard correction. Server-side entitlement remains authoritative.

workstreams.title: Security configuration, supply chain, and reproducible deployment gates
workstreams.scope: Fail closed on unsafe biometric production configuration, triage and minimally upgrade exploitable dependencies, and restore reproducible FastAPI/PostgreSQL/Redis/Celery container recipes.
prerequisites: full settled P1 tree for final gate
workstreams.target_outcome: Unsafe biometric settings are rejected, known advisories are dispositioned with tests, and documented container builds boot the actual retained stack.
subsystems: Settings/biometric provider and encryption key validation
exit_criteria: Production config rejects fake biometric provider and test keys before startup.
Each F27 advisory has reachability, deployed-version, remediation, or accepted-blocker evidence.
Minimal dependency upgrades pass security and full regression gates.
Application/test containers build from tracked files and readiness proves API, DB, Redis, worker, and scheduler ownership.
No deployment or production mutation occurs.
workstreams.rollback: Revert dependency/container changes as one reviewed manifest set when incompatible; retain the biometric fail-closed guard. Never fall back to fake identity outcomes in production.
